label: Riser Doors
summary: Fire-rated steel access doors to service risers and shafts, supplied and installed.
_PROVISIONAL: INTERNAL NOTE — never rendered in the interface or the PDF. This file describes the riser door CATEGORY as the customer configures it: the fields on the Specify page. Approved sizes, walls, frames and locks live in data/christo-riser-door.json (from the Kiwa Field of Application report) and are resolved by lib/riserMatch.js. Fire ratings keep the EW labels for now at the business's request; the Kiwa report itself evidences integrity to BS 476: Part 22.

statedLimits.source: Derived from the largest approved leaf envelopes in PAR/21319/01 plus the frame deductions. The report permits unlimited size reduction; the minimum here is a form-sanity floor only.

clearOpening.note: Clear opening is the structural opening less 201 mm on width and 75 mm on height.

structuralAllowance.note: Prepare the structural opening 16 mm larger than the ordered door. The frame provides in-frame adjustment, so no packers or mastic are needed.

fireClassificationNote: Approved for up to 120 minutes fire resistance, tested from both directions of exposure.

options.label: Handing
options.note: Viewed from the access side. For multi-leaf sets this is the active leaf.

options.label: Acoustic requirement
options.note: State the rating the Acoustic Report asks for.

choices.label: Low-resin powder for over-painting
choices.note: Formulated to take emulsion and blend into the surrounding wall. No extra cost.
